observations: Triplinone F is assigned C11 R by comparison with the synthesized C11 epimer (main p3); natural-product 13C shifts were reconstructed from HSQC and recalibrated (SI p4).
SI provides the reduction/acetonide/oxidation route omitted from the main three-step arrows.
SI 6a/6b isolated yields are 40.2% and 25.8%, not 66% for each compound.
SI 7a/7b are crude products; 8a and 8b have two-step yields 94% and 88%. Main Scheme 1 separately lists rounded individual yields.
Source wavy bonds at C11 in 4, 10 and 11 are not completed to a single configuration. Ketone 12 removes this uncertainty before asymmetric reduction.
